description: Black and white full length photograph of Georgia O'Keeffe and Todd Webb sitting on the wooden well cover in the courtyard of the Abiquiu house.  O'Keeffe is dressed in a black suit with a vest and black shoes with her hair pulled back and hands in lap. Webb is wearing a light colored jacket, shirt and pants and leather work boots with his hands on his knees holding a cap. Wooden door and adobe walls visible in the background.
title: O'Keeffe and Todd Webb
